entities.title: A separate cosmetic generator
entities.summary: The picture draws from its own generator; the main generator keeps the view-independent stardust draws as discarded draws.
entities.context: The baseline drew some cosmetic numbers from the main generator, so the picture could change the rules' stream.
entities.decision: CosmeticGenerator serves the picture; MainGenerator keeps the 54 and 9 stardust draws, discarded (RULES 1, deliberate difference 3).
entities.rationale: Parity stays provable, and the picture can change without changing the game.
